about: Qwen3.5-4B (revision 851bf6e8), the paper's base-to-instruct ReLU steers and LoRAs, seeds 1-3: theta_C (constitution), theta_K (control), -theta_K (theta_K with its write negated, applied as stored) and theta_C - theta_K (the difference object), plus the refusal steer (Arditi et al., 2024) at c = +0.5 and -0.5 and the safety positive controls (one ReLU steer and one LoRA distilled from a safety-refusal system prompt, fit on the instruct checkpoint). Aggregates of the geometry analysis's forward-pass job (geom-fwd-0074823) and weight analyses, bound to the objects by sha256.

judge.note: judge-free: teacher-forced forward passes on fixed text (the unsteered model's replies) and weight geometry; no generation is graded, so no judge enters any number here

provenance.lanes: the geometry analysis's judge-free lanes: the forward-pass job and the weight analyses; their files are outside this repository and are named here relative to the lanes' analysis directory, each with its sha256

projection.directions_note: the refusal directions refit at the block OUTPUT (resid_post, index l = the output of decoder block l) from the paper fit's train prompts with its filter, unit-normalised; the fit's own resid_pre means shifted by one block agree to cosine 0.99999
projection.quantity: mean over prompts of the projection of the post-instruction residual state on the unit refusal direction of the same layer and position; a change is (steered - unsteered) per prompt, averaged

writes.texts: T2+T3 (attack and benign prompts with the unsteered model's replies), tokens after the first

directions.note: the paper fit's harmful-minus-harmless means at every layer but the last and the 9 post-instruction positions (resid_pre); a ReLU write at block l pairs with the direction at index l + 1
